text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having safely run the race against her 
rival, Admire Vega is led away by T.M. 
Opera O—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While denying that was the case, she 
nonetheless set her sights on the Japan 
Cup for her next race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Watching her run the Senior Autumn Triple 
Crown with a thumping heart, I renewed my 
resolve to support her with everything 
I've got.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There was one Umamusume who acutely felt 
the gap between herself and her peers.
